summary: Verified all 34 source files and upheld the selected-gene comparison. All 358 paired effects agreed in direction, and 49 passed both FDR cutoffs. The proposal counted 55 published discoveries. The BH-adjusted values establish 61 across the full registered fit, including six unpublished discoveries. Coverage of 358/405 author genes (88.40%) and one additional rat per registered arm preclude author-concordance-v2 acceptance. The corrected proposal passed the repository checker.
openIssues: The reviewed sources omit the unfiltered author result table and raw P values. The six unpublished registered discoveries cannot be identified from the published table.
The current GEO family SOFT checksum differs from its historical pin. All 12 registered sample identities and assignments matched the current record.
